messages:
sam_pm: Heads-up: we need a tight rollout for the 'Progressive Shepherd' plan — goal is graceful degradation under GPU pressure. want a concise flag lifecycle, canary cadence, AB/shadow plan, and private-deploy behavior. quick takes?
lia_eng: propose three ordered fallbacks: 1) token-shed (trim prompts), 2) context-reduce (shorten backstory), 3) model-fallback (lower-cost variant). flags should support per-tenant overrides and region gates.
noah_sre: safety windows: canary 0.5% for 20m, then 2% for 45m, then 10% for 2h. auto-pause if error_rate > 0.8% or 95p latency > 2.5s during window. include circuit-breaker with TTL 10m.
anya_data: telemetry list: per-route latency_hist, fallback_rate, tokens_saved, quality_delta, cohort_sample_ids. require daily dump of 2k sampled prompts (hashed) for offline eval. set AB shadow at 5% for 24h to get quality signal.
kevin_sales: enterprise ask: default opt-out, must allow customer to opt-in via tenant setting. show an impact preview in console and send changelog email for enabled tenants.
ops_ravi: runbook: 1) toggle region kill-switch 2) set flag to last-stable variant 3) cap traffic slices and scale instance counts 4) notify customers. need CLI parity for emergency toggles.
lia_eng: flag proto (pseudo): ```json
{
  "flag":"progressive_shepherd_v1",
  "variants":["full","token_shed","context_trim","fallback_small"],
  "stages":[{"pct":0.5,"min":20},{"pct":2,"min":45}],
  "region_overrides":{"eu":{"pct":1}},
  "tenant_whitelist":["beta_*"],
  "circuit_ttl_s":600
}
```
sam_pm: good. add acceptance criteria: <1% customer-impacting errors across 48h rollout and quality_delta <=0.5% on eval set. also require nightly regression alert.
noah_sre: note for private deployments: must expose local-only fallbacks and disable auto-routing to hosted models. telemetry opt-out must be honored; provide an on-prem telemetry collector option.
anya_data: A/B plan: run paired cohorts, collect human evals on border cases, compute quality_delta per-customer-cohort, and reject rollout if delta fails thresholds. shadow compare to be kept 7 days for trend.
kevin_sales: also need a short customer-facing FAQ explaining why fallbacks happen and how to opt-out. ops/UI must surface expected token savings and change in latency.
lia_eng: engineering caveat: context_trim requires KV cache alignment; if we switch mid-session, we must synthesize system message to avoid context leak. backlog ticket created.
sre-bot: deploybot: applied canary policy progressive_shepherd on prod-canary at 1717992055. monitoring hooks enabled.
sam_pm: thanks team — i'll author the rollout playbook draft with flag schema, telemetry contract, runbook, and customer comms. owners to comment by EOW.
